newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech cenbank sets 13-wk T-bill auction at 20 pct.
newsitem.headline: Czech cenbank sets 13-wk T-bill auction at 20 pct.

text.p: The Czech National Bank set an auction offering 10 billion crowns in 13-week Finance Ministry treasury bills for Wednesday with the maximum acceptable gross yield set at 20 percent, the CNB said on Tuesday.

Czech short and medium-term interest rates have risen sharply in the past month after the central bank squeezed out liquidity to prevent short selling in the crown which came under attack at the end of May.
Average gross yield in the last 13-week T-bill auction on April 17 was 11.6 percent. A similar auction planned in May was cancelled because of the situation on the market.
